description.title: ניכוי
description.summary: This table details the deductible amounts applicable to cleanup costs, loss, or other loss under a pollution liability insurance policy. It outlines how the deductible applies to pollution events and potential reductions based on mediation.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את סכומי הניכוי החלים על עלויות ניקיון, הפסדים או הפסדים אחרים במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום. ניתן למצוא כאן את אופן יישום הניכוי לאירועי זיהום והפחתות פוטנציאליות המבוססות על גישור. הפוליסה כוללת ניכוי עבור 'אירוע זיהום' או סדרת אירועים קשורים. הניכוי אינו פוגע בסכומי האחריות. ניתן להקטין את הניכוי ב-50% עבור תביעה ספציפית, עד למקסימום של 25,000 דולר. הפוליסה מתייחסת ל'מבוטח' ו'תביעה'.

sketch:
D.  DEDUCTIBLE
We will pay 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" to which this insurance applies in  excess  of  the  Deductible  set  forth  in  Item  4  or  Item  5  (corresponding  with  an insuring  agreement  specifically  listed  as  provided)  of  the  Declarations  or  as  set forth  in  an  endorsement  to  this  policy,  if  any.    The  Deductible  is  the  "named insured's"  obligation  and  applies  to  all  "cleanup  costs',  'loss',  and  "other  loss" arising from the same, continuous or repeated "pollution event" or series of related 'pollution events".  The Deductible does not erode the Limits of Liability.  We may advance payment for 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" within the Deductible. The  "named  insured"  shall  promptly  reimburse  us  for  advancing  any  element  of
such 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" paid by us within the Deductible. If an "insured" agrees with us to use non-binding mediation to resolve a 'claim' for which  a  defense  has  been  provided  and  such  'claim'  is  resolved  thereby,  the Deductible shall be reduced by 50% for that 'claim' only, subject to a maximum reduction of $25,000.

טבלה: ניכוי
This table details the deductible amounts applicable to cleanup costs, loss, or other loss under a pollution liability insurance policy. It outlines how the deductible applies to pollution events and potential reductions based on mediation.
ממדים: Deductible conditions and reductions, Deductible application and related terms

D.  DEDUCTIBLE
We will pay 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" to which this insurance applies in  excess  of  the  Deductible  set  forth  in  Item  4  or  Item  5  (corresponding  with  an insuring  agreement  specifically  listed  as  provided)  of  the  Declarations  or  as  set forth  in  an  endorsement  to  this  policy,  if  any.    The  Deductible  is  the  "named insured's"  obligation  and  applies  to  all  "cleanup  costs',  'loss',  and  "other  loss" arising from the same, continuous or repeated "pollution event" or series of related 'pollution events".  The Deductible does not erode the Limits of Liability.  We may advance payment for 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" within the Deductible. The  "named  insured"  shall  promptly  reimburse  us  for  advancing  any  element  of
such 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" paid by us within the Deductible. If an "insured" agrees with us to use non-binding mediation to resolve a 'claim' for which  a  defense  has  been  provided  and  such  'claim'  is  resolved  thereby,  the Deductible shall be reduced by 50% for that 'claim' only, subject to a maximum reduction of $25,000.
